title: Book to Skill: turns any technical book into a skill that loads only the chapter needed
description:
Book to Skill converts a technical book or documentation folder into an agent skill that loads only the chapter needed for a question. A local extractor cleans the source, then the generator builds a compact SKILL file, chapter notes, glossary, patterns, and quick-reference rules. It supports PDFs, EPUBs, office documents, and plain text, with OCR required for scanned PDFs. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/Leutenegger/book-to-skill
